verdict.rationale: Codex documents plugins that connect it to your team's tools and data, and MCP support for adding local or remote third-party servers such as Figma or browser tools. That configuration is shared across the CLI, IDE extension and desktop app, and Codex cloud can start work from GitHub, GitLab, Linear and Slack. However, this is tool and connector integration rather than a documented ecosystem of partner-built agent apps. missing for 10: an explicit partner/third-party agent app catalog or marketplace, docs on how partner-built agents plug into Codex workflows, admin controls for approving partner apps, independent or hands-on corroboration.
